summary.text: Jon Hawkins is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 55, where he has served since 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
A sales engineer from Pleasant Grove, he holds a B.A. and M.B.A. from Brigham Young University.

paragraphs.text: Hawkins was born in Utah and lives in Pleasant Grove, and he graduated from Mountain View High School in 1997.
He earned a B.A. in communications in 2002 and an M.B.A. in 2010, both from Brigham Young University.
His career included work as a sales engineer, sales engineer manager, director of partner solutions and solutions consulting manager at Workfront.
He served on the Pleasant Grove Planning Commission from 2016 to 2018.
Hawkins has served in the Utah House since 2019 and, according to Ballotpedia, chaired the Judiciary Committee in 2021-2022 and the Government Operations Committee in 2023-2024.
